verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business phone and texting product, so auto-replies and scheduled texts are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no SMS auto-reply, missed-call text-back, after-hours text reply, or scheduled-send capability. The auto attendants and TTS greetings it does document handle voice calls only, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
